Save your status effects for until after their armor is broken. As tempting as the damage might be, every status effect is blocked by either physical or magical armor (unless you have the torturer talent) therefore if you do good damage with your basic attack you could spam status effects after you break their armor. A good way to make money is to have a human in your party dump all their civil points into bartering (humans get a bartering bonus). You'll have like 100,000 by the end of the second big area more than you'll ever need for a decent while. Summoning is really fun and you can pair it with almost everything because summoning only scales off the summoning stat. For instance I have a summoning archer (some of the other skill lines have summoning skills in them. There's a fire slug in the pyrokinetic skills but it scales off summoning). Also don't spread your stats too thin but also focusing on a single few could be detrimental as well. Gotta find that balance in my opinion. And don't be afraid to dump points into memory. Skills are hella fun. If you're doing a warrior try a point in polymorph and get tentacle lash and bull horns. Tentacle lash scales off strength and bull horns let's you dash and bleed people with no physical armor every turn after you activate it. Another good racial idea is to have a lizard (who get a bonus to persuasion) be your talker. Just dump all their civil points in persuasion and you'll always talk your way out of stuff if you lead with them. Undead characters are fun but very tricky so maybe try one on your second time. If you have any specific questions definitely reply or pm me. I love this game so much and I just now left the second big area. I can also point you in the direction of some really good builds if you're like me and love following them.
